style.prompt: An 8-second widescreen charming cartoon animation. A little orange robot with rounded corners, tiny feet, expressive friendly eyes, and a small watering can gently waters one leafy green plant in a terracotta pot on a low table. Cozy ordinary everyday moment, tender and quietly cheerful. Soft pastel background, warm light, clean appealing cartoon shapes, subtle hand-drawn texture. Single continuous shot, fixed camera, medium-wide composition showing the whole little robot, watering can and potted plant. Robot carefully tips watering can, a gentle visible stream of water falls into the pot's soil, then robot straightens the can and admires the plant. Smooth understated motion, consistent robot and plant throughout. IMPORTANT: the exact text 'Small steps' is centered at the top of the frame, clearly readable in a simple rounded dark font, stationary and unchanged, visible from the very first frame through the last frame for the entire video. Leave uncluttered space behind the title. No other text. Silent video, no audio, no music, no speech, no sound effects.
